We need to enumerate possible slabs from bulk Cu2O structure and save result as JSON file, then output path.

We have a CIF file at given path. Need to read it, then call enumerate_slabs_text with appropriate parameters. Likely default Miller (1,1,1), min_slab_size 12, min_vacuum_size 5. Use tool enumerate_slabs_text.
